grammar_focus: 动词 + 介词固定搭配(主考:dream/think/hear + of · receive/suffer/borrow + from · believe/succeed/persist + in · depend/rely/insist + on · 介词后接动名词 dream of doing)+ 过去进行时作背景 / throw 不规则动词(辅考:we were traveling…put · throw-threw-thrown)
scene: 女儿简把写着姓名地址的纸条塞进瓶子扔进大海;十个月后竟收到荷兰一位同龄姑娘的来信——如今两人定期通信,只是改用了邮寄,虽贵一点却快得多

grammar_card.title: 动词后面跟哪个介词(of / from / in / on)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲一批'动词 + 介词'的固定搭配:哪个动词后面跟 of、哪个跟 from、哪个跟 in、哪个跟 on。介词后面接动词时要用动名词。全用本课句子举例。

rows: Jane never dreamed of receiving a letter.
She received a letter from a girl in Holland.
+ in:believe / succeed / persist / take part in
They believe in writing to each other.
Now they depend on the mail.

specialRules.rule: 介词后面接动词用动名词:dream of receiving, think of doing
throw 是不规则动词:throw – threw – thrown

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How did Jane receive a letter from a stranger?
options: A girl in Holland found the bottle Jane threw into the sea
A friend gave her the letter
She found it in a store
Her teacher mailed it to her

passage: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland. Last year, we were traveling across the English Channel, and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle. She threw the bottle into the sea. She never thought of it again, but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland. The two girls write to each other regularly now. However, they have decided to use the mail. Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.

grammar_points.name: 介词后接动名词(dream of doing)
过去进行时作背景 + 一般过去时(辅考)

stage5.stem: dream(梦想)后面通常接哪个介词?
"Jane never dreamed ___ receiving a letter."(梦想到、想到)
stage5.stem_cn: 简从没想过会收到一封信。

stage5.stem: receive / suffer / borrow 后面常接哪个介词?
"She received a letter ___ a girl in Holland."(收到…的来信)
stage5.stem_cn: 她收到了荷兰一位姑娘的来信。

stage5.stem: believe / succeed / persist 后面常接哪个介词?
"They believe ___ writing to each other."(信奉、坚持)
stage5.stem_cn: 她们相信要常常互相写信。

stage5.stem: depend / rely / insist 后面常接哪个介词?
"It all depends ___ the weather."(取决于、全看)
介词(of / in / on…)后面接动词时,要用:
"I dream of ___ a pilot."(dream of + 动名词:成为)
stage5.stem_cn: 我梦想成为一名飞行员。

stage5.stem: "She is interested in ___ stamps."(对…感兴趣:收集)
"The medicine saved him ___ death."(救他免于)
"We ___ traveling when Jane threw the bottle."(过去进行时作背景:正在旅行)
stage5.stem_cn: 简扔瓶子时,我们正在旅行途中。

stage5.stem: 过去进行时(was/were + 动词-ing)在故事里常用来:
options: 描述当时正在进行的背景

stage5.stem: throw 的过去式和过去分词是:
"She ___ the bottle into the sea."(throw 的过去式:扔)
